points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, metadata, props?, toModel })` declares the block. `flavour` is the type id, written `affine:<name>` ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role`
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (`'content'`, `'hub'` or `'root'`) and the allowed `children` and `parent` flavours.
`class XBlockModel extends BlockModel<Props>` is the data class.

It is a Lit element ... It builds on `BlockComponent` from `@blocksuite/std` ... It calls `this.renderChildren(this.model)` to render nested blocks. ... `setup(context)` registers `BlockViewExtension('affine:divider', literal\`affine-divider\`)`.

**`store.ts`** has `XStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider`. ... **`view.ts`** has `XViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider`. ... The editor or app (for example the `affine-shared`/`ext-loader` extension manager) then registers the Store and View providers.
`effect()` calls `effects()` to define the custom element.
